charter: Explore the tenant check on the CSV receipt import with the bug's minimal_repro (import any CSV exported from <tenant B> while logged in as <tenant A>; one row is enough) to discover whether another tenant's rows are still accepted into <tenant A>'s receipt list and running total.

areas_covered: Post-import receipt list and running expense total

notes.text: Probe 1: the minimal_repro as written, a 1-row <tenant B> export imported as <tenant A>, re-run once from a clean start.
The row is now rejected from the receipt list with "Row belongs to another account", yet the running total still rises by its amount.
Probe 2: the generalization's 40-row export; all 40 rows are rejected from the list and the total rises by their sum.

bugs.summary: Cross-tenant import fix is partial: rejected rows still add to the importing tenant's total
bugs.repro: Log in as <tenant A>; note the running expense total; import a 1-row receipts CSV exported from <tenant B>; compare the receipt list and the total with their values before the import.
bugs.observed: The row was reported rejected and is absent from the receipt list, but <tenant A>'s running total rose by the row's amount.
bugs.why_wrong: Data must never cross tenants; <tenant B>'s amount now sits in <tenant A>'s expense total.
bugs.oracle: Never/Always invariant: data never crosses tenants
bugs.minimal_repro: Import a 1-row CSV exported from <tenant B> while logged in as <tenant A>, then read the running total.
bugs.worst_observed: <tenant A>'s running expense total includes the summed amounts of 40 rejected <tenant B> rows.
bugs.generalization: Shown with a 1-row and a 40-row export; not tried with other tenant pairs.
bugs.stakeholder_impact: Every tenant: another tenant's amounts can be pushed into an account's expense total, which is money wrong across a tenant boundary.

questions_risks.text: Is the running total recomputed from stored receipts, or is it a counter the import updates before the tenant check runs?

off_charter.item: The receipt API and email-in import paths were not re-checked against the new tenant check.
off_charter.candidate_charter: Explore the receipt API and email-in import paths with exports from another tenant to discover whether they apply the new tenant check.

debrief.explored: A verify-mode re-check of the cross-tenant import Critical: probe 1 ran the minimal_repro (re-run once from a clean start), probe 2 the generalization's 40-row export. 2 of 2 probes, 9 tool calls; stopped because the verdict was in.
debrief.found: verify result fail: the fix is partial. Rows from another tenant no longer reach <tenant A>'s receipt list, but their amounts still reach its running total (2/2, Critical).
debrief.unknown: This verify result covers the cross-tenant import bug only, never the original charter's other risks; other import paths and other tenant pairs were not tried.

verify.evidence: The 1-row <tenant B> export was rejected from <tenant A>'s receipt list, yet <tenant A>'s running total rose by its amount; the 40-row export did the same with the summed amounts.
